analysis: Only base_text excerpts of docs/developer/test.md (lines 1-870) were supplied for this file. It is relevant to TB-011 and T-053 through the test descriptions, and to T-041 through the SSD test descriptions. The base text states that these tests do not qualify native Apple behavior and that the harness never stops an operator process or reads installed auth. If the PR edits this file, the next pass should check whether any new wording overstates qualification, such as App Attest, resumption or SSD TTL/disk-budget claims, or instructs tests to use production credentials, installed auth, or the operator's live daemon. Because the diff is unavailable, this is a coverage limit and not evidence that the change is safe.
